verdict: The law does NOT survive as an accounting instrument. A reader cannot trust a law-computed bill. Non-avalanche branch (residue 2-63, one warm append) is exactly right; residue {0,1} overstates by P1-64; multi-turn conversational bills are outside the law's stated scope (LAW.md section 8) and are QUALITY-ARM's entire regime.
